summary: Single session, nothing to remember: add `--default` to `dotenv get`. Measures memory-system overhead only. The trap patch is a plausible buggy version (`values.get(key) or default`) that replaces real empty-string values with the default.

turns: Add a `--default` option to `dotenv get`: if the key is missing or has no value, print the default and exit 0 instead of failing. Keys set to an empty string count as having a value, so those still print empty. Tests too.
